title: SIH26034 Dataset Source Manifest
description: Metadata specification for tracking dataset sources and licensing

sourceUrl.description: URL where the dataset can be retrieved or verified

license.description: The exact license name (e.g. CC-BY 4.0, ODbL, Custom Commercial)

attributionRequired.description: True if the license requires attribution

commercialUseAllowed.description: True if the license allows commercial use without special permission

redistributionAllowed.description: True if we are allowed to redistribute the dataset

imageCount.description: Number of images in this dataset source

countryOrMarket.description: Primary market or country of origin for the products (e.g. India, International)

annotationType.description: The primary annotation format provided by this source

relevantClasses.description: The SIH26034 YOLO classes this dataset is useful for training
